UpdateMysqlRateLimitTask.filterKey: FilterKey. Rate limit keywords. Multiple keyword groups are separated by commas. Supports the utf8 character set. Except for commas serving as keyword separators, no other restrictions apply.
UpdateMysqlRateLimitTask.filterLimit: FilterLimit. Concurrency of the rate limit rule: value ranges from 0 to 1,000,000 (inclusive).
UpdateMysqlRateLimitTask.filterType: FilterType. SQL rate limit type. Supports SELECT, UPDATE, INSERT, DELETE, and REPLACE.
